description: Shared test vectors for the khatwa laptop lock codes (v3, digits). code6(secret, msg) = HMAC-SHA256(key = secret UTF-8, msg UTF-8), offset = h[31] & 0x0F, value = ((h[off] & 0x7F) << 24 | h[off+1] << 16 | h[off+2] << 8 | h[off+3]) mod 1000000, zero-padded to 6 digits. lockCode = code6(secret, 'lock:' + counter); unlockCode = code6(secret, 'unlock:' + counter). nextCounter(secret, last) = first n > last whose lock code differs from the lock codes of the 1000 counters before it. Both the Kotlin (core/) and C# (laptop-lock/) tests must pass every vector; they were generated by an independent Python implementation.

pairing.description: New pairing codes are 6 random digits + 2 check digits (ISO 7064 MOD 97-10, as in IBAN): check = 98 - (first6 * 100 mod 97), and a code is valid iff its 8-digit value mod 97 == 1. This catches every single wrong digit and every swap of two neighbouring digits; a random 8-digit number passes about 1 time in 97. Secrets saved before check digits existed stay usable; only typed pairing codes are checked.
